dawn: A soft chime marks the start of a new test cycle.
morning: Somewhere in the grid, instruments click through their calibration sequence.
midday: The overhead indicators cycle through green, amber, green.
afternoon: A distant terminal prints a long stream of status codes.
dusk: The grid lighting dims one notch as the day-cycle winds down.
night: The testbed hums quietly. Background processes tick on.
midnight: All indicators show nominal. The grid is at rest.
